text: Anita Bunny Ge First of all my visa process is already happening since 2 years (I went to court and everything with my lawyer, they are amazing and I won my case which happens very rarely). In August 2025 we had an appointment to hand in documents and they gave us an appointment for the interview only now for May 2026. The interview went well and the clerk said that I will get the visa, but because there was such a big gap between both appointments she wants an updated version of the documents since 08/2025 until now. My lawyer had them printed out but they didn’t take them and said only online. My lawyer tried multiple times but there is always an Error showing up.
